verdict.rationale: cubic is a code-review SaaS, not an agent, so an official MCP server fits its product type. It documents one: coding agents can connect to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage PR and scan issues (cubic-docs-15, cubic-probe-3). The server also exposes subscription and seat management from the MCP client (cubic-docs-3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and evidenced setup details such as authentication, transport, and the full tool list.
